test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The CEO called for __compulsory__ participation from each employee.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"compulsory"** means something that is required by law or a rule; obligatory. (अनिवार्य)

 
 
• **Example: **Wearing seat belts in cars is **compulsory** in many countries.
 
 
 
• **"Voluntary"** refers to something that is done, given, or acting of one's own free will. (स्वैच्छिक)
 
 
• **Example: **Participation in the charity event was entirely **voluntary.**
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'compulsory'** is **'voluntary'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Obligatory **(अनिवार्य): Required by a legal, moral, or other rule; compulsory.

 
 
• **Example:** It is obligatory for students to attend the assembly.
 
 
 
• **Compliantly **(अनुपालन करते हुए): In a manner that shows a willingness to comply with a request or command.
 
 
• **Example: **She followed the instructions compliantly.
 
 
 
• **Overtly** (खुलेआम): In an open and observable manner; not hidden or secret.
 
 
• **Example:** The company overtly supports environmental causes.

The correct answer is O
